title: IPL Team Ownership Deals: RCB ($1.78B) & Rajasthan Royals ($1.63B)
summary: **Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) Record Sale:** United Spirits Limited (USL) sold RCB for a record valuation of **$1.78 Billion (₹16,660 Crore)** to a consor...

items: **Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) Record Sale:** United Spirits Limited (USL) sold RCB for a record valuation of **$1.78 Billion (₹16,660 Crore)** to a consortium comprising Aditya Birla Group, Times of India Group, Blackstone, and Bolt Ventures.
**Rajasthan Royals Equity Transaction:** Manoj Badale sold controlling equity in Rajasthan Royals to US-based investor Kal Somani for **$1.63 Billion**.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → RCB sold for record $1.78 Billion (₹16,660 Cr) vs Rajasthan Royals at $1.63 Billion.
